concepts.gloss_en: The study of the plain/simple level of Torah — an act of learning that is itself called a form of 'sleep' relative to cleaving to the Creator

reason_for_human: Single occurrence in lm1:35, where the phrase 'לִמּוּד פְּשָׁטָא אוֹרַיְתָא' names the activity of studying the plain level of Torah, explicitly equated with 'sleep' via a שהוא-equation. The gloss correctly captures the study-activity sense (not the peshat text itself). Nothing to split or merge.
